entities.summary: Dimitar Ganev Varbanov was a Bulgarian communist politician. He became the Chairman of the Presidium of the National Assembly of Bulgaria on 30 November 1958, shortly after the death of Georgi Damyanov, and served in that capacity until his own death on 20 April 1964.
